name: Session Checkpoint Guard
summary: Append a deterministic, hash-chained session-end receipt to the local session ledger.
description: On SessionEnd, append a bounded receipt (timestamp, reason, sequence, chain link, git anchor) to .youdede/session-ledger.jsonl. Rich content belongs to the record-work-checkpoint command; this hook records only what the event proves.
refuses: It does not block, delay, or alter the observed event; it records or reports only.
It does not execute submitted content, call an LLM, or transmit any data off the machine.
It does not treat unreadable, symlinked, or oversized state as valid evidence.

entrypoints.purpose: Append a tamper-evident session-end receipt to the chained ledger.
